requirement: The system shall accept named gauge values, persist those values, and make them available for use in display layouts.

The system shall register displays with unique identifiers and resolutions and persist their availability, orientation, display data, and assigned layouts. When an assigned layout is deleted, the system shall clear the affected display's layout assignment.

The system shall provide a browser-based TypeScript/React single-page editor with Redux state management for creating, editing, and saving layouts. Users shall be able to position text, gauges, and other data across multiple displays and render or remove layout elements while editing.
The system shall render each display's data as a black-and-white pixel view at that display's resolution.
The supplied development environment shall include Python/Django and PostgreSQL, and the server shall serve the built browser editor as static assets.
